item.title: Binary Star (hip-hop group)
item.description: Binary Star is an underground hip-hop duo from Pontiac, Michigan. The duo consists of rapper One Be Lo (also known as OneManArmy), rapper Senim Silla, and producer Decompoze. The pair met in high school and formed the group in 1998 during their time in Hiawatha Correctional Facility.
